svg.title: One-shot process-wide selector cabinet
svg.desc: Original sixty-solid figure:one latched selector spans multiple group trays.The seal represents modeled process lifetime,not cryptographic equipment or actual keys.

g.text: FIG145 · ONE PROCESS-WIDE LATCH, NOT ONE SECRET PER GROUP
Destroying groups does not reset the process-wide key
First nccl2 group gates the latch;rejected key application does not consume it
Later groups inherit or match;environment changes do not rotate an applied key
TCP TLS scope excludes GPU data paths,external net plugins and the c10d Store
Original metadata-only teaching figure · no secret material,TLS/communicators/GPU execution or visual browser inspection
